title: Facile, low-cost, and environment-friendly method for preparing peanut shell-based activated carbon: application to dichloromethane removal
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27311-27333
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01361E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Saeed Hassan Boroojerdi, Mohsen Mir Mohammadi, Farzad Bahadoran
This research explores air pollution from DCM, focusing on adsorption-based removal. AC from PS's was developed via a single-step eco-friendly process. Promising adsorption results suggest potential for industrial-scale applications.
